nom: Timebeam Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50

avis.titre: Love the lightweight formula and glow
avis.texte: Mineral sunscreens typically feel heavy on my skin, but I love the weight of this SPF, and the healthy glow it gives my skin. I also like that it does not have heavy fragrance like many mineral sunscreens have to cover up the natural scent of zinc oxide. I needed to give the cap a strong twist the first time, but easy to use after that.

This unfortunately didn't work for me it made my combination skin extremely dry & flakey. I wanted to love it. Great packaging & a little mixer ball which I thought was innovative. But not matter why I used under it for serum & moisturizer it dried my skin out extremely bad. Bummed it won't work.

Not only is this product protecting my skin with 50 spf it is also helping with the tone of my skin. I absolutely love this product and the benefits. Helping with fine lines and hydration at the same time, it is definitely going to be needed as the summer months approach

This sunscreen is very cute (pink!) and the bottle is easy to carry in your purse. Its texture is lightweight and milky, and blends in nicely into my skin. I think it's great for daily use when it's not very hot out and you don't plan to work up a sweat. It's not meant to be used in the water or when you're going to be sweating, so I just make it a part of my morning skincare routine since it has skin-happy ingredients. The one thing I didn't care for was the smell. It's scentless, but it has a weird stink to it -- hard to describe. Thankfull doesn't stink once applied to my face. I received this as a part of an educational promotion.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: I've been testing the Timebeam Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 and overall, I actually really like it. It's a mineral SPF, but it doesn't feel heavy or overly chalky like a lot of zinc-based formulas can. The texture is lightweight and spreads easily, and it gives the skin a really nice hydrated, slightly dewy finish without feeling greasy. I also appreciate that it's fragrance-free and feels gentle, especially on days when my skin is a little more sensitized. What stands out to me is the added antioxidant support — ingredients like astaxanthin and green tea help protect against environmental stress while also supporting the skin barrier . It feels more like skincare + SPF in one, which I'm always a fan of. There is a slight mineral feel initially, but it blends in well and sits nicely under makeup. Overall, I think this is a solid everyday mineral sunscreen, especially if you prefer a more nourishing, glowy finish rather than something matte. I still reapply and don't rely on any SPF alone, but this has been an easy one to reach for daily.

This immediately jumped into my number one spot for SPF. It is very lightweight and fluid. It is so easy to work into the skin without any sign of cast. The glow it gives my skin is like nothing else. It looks amazing under makeup or just on its own. As a fair skinned girl I go through a lot of SPF and have tried most out there and this is above them all. Highly recommend.

Not only it protects my skin from the sun damage, but it also makes my skin glow. I'm very impressed. No white residue, just my glowing skin. Also it is a mineral sunscreen and doesn't contain harsh chemicals so it is good for the environment. If you get in the water wearing it the fish will not die.

avis.titre: I love this mineral based sunscreen!
avis.texte: If I find a sunscreen that doesn't cause irritation or numbs for me, it's a lottery wining. My face is extremely sensitive to sunscreens however I've found that mineral sunscreens work best and this one is great. It apply evenly, smooth and I noticed no white cast. I used it both without makeup and with. It did not cause any problems with my makeup application. I liked it without makeup too because I feel like it gave me skin a glow. I spend a lot of time outside everyday so I'm always looking for the best sunscreen product. Honestly, this one gets a 10/10 for me. The only other sunscreen I've ever found I like for my face is the Caudalie but it's very watery and liquid which makes it difficult to apply. This one is a thicker texture but not too thick. I definitely recommend for those looking for a mineral based sunscreen.

I use sunscreen every day, so I was excited to try the Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen, especially since it is SPF 50 which is what I usually look for. The packaging is really cute and travel friendly, though I did find the cap a bit hard to remove. The formula feels lightweight on the skin, which I liked, but it is a little runny and can be harder to apply evenly. One of my favorite things about it is that it does not leave a white cast at all and gives a nice dewy glow without feeling greasy. It also has a slight sparkle in the formula. It did not bother me, but I can see how that might not be for everyone depending on personal preference. I received this product as part of an educational promotion.

I've tried a lot of sunscreens and this one actually surprised me. The TIMEBEAM Sunbeam Daily Mineral SPF 50 feels lightweight and doesn't leave that thick, chalky white cast most mineral sunscreens do. It blends in pretty easily and sits nicely under makeup without pilling. My skin is a bit sensitive and I had zero irritation or breakouts using it daily. It gives a soft, natural finish and a dewy glow but not greasy. I also love that it doesn't have a strong smell. Overall, it just feels easy to wear every day, which is rare for SPF honestly.

I like the high spf of this product and will use it for extended exposure on my face for places like the beach. The bottle is quite small for the price so it is not what I would use for my everyday sunscreen coverage. I like the added skincare benefits mentioned in the packaging and I also find it to be convenient for travel. It took me a minute to figure out how to open the bottle and I do not think it's very intuitive, although it's good that it's well sealed. I have brown skin, but the product blends in well without leaving a white cast. I don't love the smell but thankfully it's not too strong.

I happily wore this every day. I have issues with sunscreen sometimes. There's always the chance that it will react with my skincare or makeup. I had no issues with this sunscreen. I never experienced pilling or weird texture under my makeup. It has a thick consistency, but I found it was easy to apply. I really enjoyed the pink tint. The packaging is cute. The only thing I'd note is I couldn't remove the lid at first. It was pretty hard to turn. I also shook the product before applying. It had an SPF of 50, which is awesome. I never had any issues with my eyes burning, which can happen easily. No skin sensitivity. All in all, I really like this sunscreen. I wear it every day and I will be sad when it's gone. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review of my experience.

avis.titre: Lightweight Protection That Feels Great on the Skin
avis.texte: I've really enjoyed using the Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50. It applies smoothly and feels lightweight on my skin, which makes it comfortable to wear throughout the day. I love that it does not leave a heavy or greasy feeling, and it blends in nicely without a noticeable white cast. It gives me confidence knowing I am protected with broad spectrum SPF 50, especially during outdoor activities. The formula feels gentle and works well with my daily routine, even under makeup. I also appreciate that it supports my skin while helping protect it from sun damage. I received this product as a part of an educational promotion.

Product was received as part of an educational promotion. As a child of the 90s, I grew up without wearing sunscreen and constant burns throughout my childhood. Because of this, I've always hated sunscreen. Now as a mom in my thirties, I fully understand the importance of sun protection & was so happy to use Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50. I love it and will probably purchase it in the future! The lotion comes out pink in color, applies white, and absorbs very quickly into my skin. There are no white streaks & it dissolves into a dewy glow! I've never loved a sunscreen so much. It is hydrating and non-irritating. I have been having some redness flare ups and this has been amazing! It claims it is "lightweight, fragrance free and non greasy," and this is absolutely the truth! It is a smaller size package, but a little goes a long way. It also allows one step skincare application, as you won't need to apply a serum or lotion with it if you don't want to. It really is an awesome product!

This new beautiful mineral sunscreen spf 50 is my new summer favorite. This has a very glowy finish so it is perfect for dry skin types like myself. It applies very smoothly and evens out your skin tone. It has a slight pink shade which works well for my pink undertone skin tone. It also leaves the skin glowy and brighter and moist looking for the whole day. But on top of that the most important part is that my skin is protected from the sun damage on the daily no matter if in direct sunlight for short or long periods of time.

There are multiple aspects of this product that i love. For starters, this facial sunscreen provides your skin with instant radiance!! Its absolutely perfect to aid people with dull, lack luster complexions. The radiance appears to come from within. The product is not super shiny or full of sparkles. Looks very natural. Another great feature is that it is suitable for those with sensitive skin. This did not cause any sensitivity or redness. I even applied this very close under my eyes with no negative reaction. I have combination skin type so I worry if a product will cause blackheads or acne. This sunscreen is definitely noncomedogenic therefore, did not encourage any breakouts. It washes off clean and easily and did not leave my face feeling greasy throughout the day. My only complaint is that it does not spread as far as my normal facial sunscreen does. I had to use a little more than usual to cover my face. But I also found a solution to that issue if it bothers me to much. Like I previously mentioned, I have combination skin type. Since I can use a little extra moisturizer, I added a drop or two of my face oil to the sunscreen I put into my palm. Mix the two together and apply evenly to my face. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review

All right, a pink sunscreen? This is everything your pink girl has been looking for. I love how it already gives me a nice pink natural glow and it blends in my skin so perfectly it feels more even like a makeup concealer that I can use prior to putting any type of blush so this pink girl here has been absolutely happy to try this out and this was given to me as a trial that I absolutely love and can't wait to continue to repurchase after this tester was given

I'm loving this lightweight Dewy formula from Timebeam. It's packed full of skin, loving ingredients which I love. I love that. It doesn't make my skin feel weighted down. It doesn't break me out and clogged my pores. It's in the cutest little bottle. That's easy to just toss into your bag. I highly recommend for anyone looking for broad spectrum SPF 50 sunscreen that doesn't weigh your skin down or leave you with the weird streaks like a lot of creamy sunscreen formulas do. And although this review was collected as part of a promotion, I really do love this product and will probably purchase again.

Timebeam Beauty's Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50 pink design is so cute, did offer a high level of sun protection , worked great for my outdoor activities especially in the sunny climate area I live in.The texture is thin not thick, the sunscreen is lightweight and non-greasy, absorbing well into the skin without leaving a heavy or white cast, It can be worn comfortably under makeup or alone, providing a matte or natural finish with glow.

I normally don't love most mineral sunscreens because they tend to leave a white cast on my skin, even though I have fair skin. This leaves ZERO white cast, and just melts into my skin. It feels like I'm wearing nothing. It has no scent either. My only issue with this sunscreen is with the packaging. It is very hard to twist open and it may be hard if you have fine motor or dexterity issues. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

I use this as the last step in my morning face routine. The texture of the spf is nice and it isn't heavy or greasy, and it provides a very subtle glow. The bottle, however, has been a struggle. I found the cap incredibly difficult to get off initially, and even now that I've figured it out, it's still a bit of a daily battle! The dispensing is also inconsistent; sometimes the product flows easily, while other times it feels like it's getting clogged or stuck. It definitely isn't the most user friendly design. In terms of skin health, I'm still on the fence. I've noticed some new congestion and breakouts on my forehead since starting this. I have been making small tweaks to my diet as well, so it is hard to pinpoint right now what is causing this, but still felt it worth mentioning. I did receive this product as part of an educational promotion.

Collected as part of a promotion! I'm honestly I'm kind of obsessed. It has this really nice natural, slightly dewy finish (not greasy at all), which I wasn't expecting from a mineral sunscreen. Usually they feel heavy or leave a white cast but this one blends in pretty well on my skin. It actually makes my skin look healthier?? I keep reaching for it every morning without thinking, which says a lot. It layers fine under makeup too, no pilling so far. Only thing is you do have to rub it in a bit more than a chemical one but thats expected. Overall its def become my go to sunscreen lately and I dont see myself switching anytime soon.

avis.titre: Best mineral sunscreen on the market
avis.texte: This is the best mineral sunscreen that I have ever tried. I was gifted this sunscreen for my honest review. I absolutely love this sunscreen. It is so milky and soft. I love the fact that when I put it on there is zero white cast I do not typically wear mineral sunscreen because I feel like every mineral sunscreen that I've ever tried leaves a white cast and the best part it's pink. The glow that this sunscreen leaves is so beautiful. It makes your skin feel extremely soft extremely smooth and extremely hydrated. It does have the usual sunscreen smell, but I always expect that from a sunscreen. I will say the smell on this one is very mild. I absolutely love the packaging. It is so sleek and so pretty and so pink I will definitely continue to purchase this sunscreen. This sunscreen has made me a mineral sunscreen girly.

It feels lightweight on the skin and gives a nice dewy glow without feeling heavy or greasy. It blends well with no noticeable residue. The tint has a soft pink tone, and the packaging is cute in the same pink vibe. It layers nicely with the rest of my routine. I like that it's an SPF 50 mineral sunscreen with zinc-based protection and added antioxidants for extra skin support. I appreciate most of the ingredients, although I'm not a fan of butyloctyl salicylate, a synthetic UV filter with potential endocrine-disrupting concerns and environmental impact. I was also disappointed that the product appeared to have already been opened and may have been used. Overall, it's easy to wear daily, gives a nice glow, and works well as part of my routine. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: Gentle sunscreen and light pink color
avis.texte: I love this sunscreen and it goes on easily on my skin and does not leave any sticky residue after applying it.It is gentle and absorbs quickly into my skin and has a light pink color.I like that the bottle makes it easy to dispense the product and it is easy to open and close the bottle.The sunscreen does not irritate my skin or sting my eye area and I used this daily on my face.My skin looks healthier and more nourished when using this sunscreen and it does not leave any sticky white caste on my skin.The scent of the sunscreen is light and not overpowering and I would recommend it to others.This sunscreen is great for the face area or any part of your body that you want to apply it to.I would use this sunscreen as the last step in my skin routine and it feels nourishing on my skin.I received this product as a part of an educational promotion.

I have been testing the Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen that I received as part of an educational promotion for around a week now and so far I love it! It's really important to me that sunscreens be 100% mineral which this one is, but I love that it has skincare in it as well, such an niacinamide, to brighten my complexion over time. It's lightweight, scent free, easy to apply, and gives me a dewey glow!

avis.titre: The ultimate protection with so many benefits for my skin
avis.texte: The Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 is great worn by itself and under make up. I love the fact that with this product I can protect my skin from UV and still look good. I mean I get it, we use sunscreen first and foremost for its efficiency at protecting our skin against the sun, but it is really a big plus, when you can have the protection and still have your skin looking dewy and glowy. This is what I love the most about this sunscreen. It does not leave a white cast, does not get patchy and leaves my skin looking radiant. The lotion is a nice pastel pink color, which is a nice touch, and it feels great on the skin. It does not feel chalky. It glides easily on the skin and is absorbed beautifully. It feels very lightweight. I can confidently wear it under my make up without worrying about if it is going to leave patches. It actually is a nice prep and base before applying my makeup, as it evens my skin tone, and the glow makes a nice canvas. This product is more than a sunscreen. With consistent use, combined with the Timebeam Sol Mate Sun Gummies, I have seen visible changes in my skin. It feels more hydrated. My skin tone is gradually evening out, and my skin has a healthy shine and glow. Whenever I expose myself to heavy sun for long hours, my skin will feel sensitive and peel the next day. But since using this product, I am happy to say, this problem is history. I also love the compact and sleek packaging that makes it easy to travel with. I cannot recommend this

Timebeam Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen gives a sheer lightweight sun protection for the face with a high sun protection factor of 50. Its dewy and hydrating formulation glides on the skin easily, while feeling cooling and refreshing. Additionally, the active ingredient of Zinc Oxide does not leave any white casting that can happen with physical sunscreens. I love that it contains the super antioxidant astaxanthin, as well as green tea, niacinamide, vitamin c and hyaluronic acid. The only thing I did not care for is an ever so slight chemical smell probably carried by the other added ingredients. On the other hand, as a specialized skincare therapist,I quite honestly believe most would not be bothered by this smell, and it is truly fragrance free as stated. Overall, a good product that delivers what it claims to. ***received as part of an educational promotion.

I had such a pleasure using TIMEBEAM Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen. The light pink bottle and the texture are so pleasant to look at. The texture is silky smooth. It applies smoothly and evenly without leaving any white cast behind. My skin looks and feels hydrated. My pores also look less visible. It is non-sticky and fragrance free. This sunscreen gives a nice, natural glow to my skin. I like the ingredients such as niacinamide and green tea. It is vegan and cruelty-free. It can be used daily. I received a free product for educational purposes.

I've been using the Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 for a little while now, and overall I really like it. First off, it gives me peace of mind knowing I'm getting solid sun protection without any irritation—my skin feels safe and comfortable throughout the day. The formula is a bit thicker than chemical sunscreens, but it blends in surprisingly well and doesn't leave a noticeable white cast, which is such a relief for a mineral SPF. I also appreciate that it feels stable under makeup—I haven't noticed any pilling or patchiness, which makes it easy to use as part of my morning routine. While it's not super hydrating or glowy on its own, it has a clean, natural finish that I actually like, especially if I pair it with a light moisturizer or serum. Overall, it's a reliable, no-fuss sunscreen that I've found myself reaching for almost every day. It's definitely not the most luxurious SPF out there, but it does exactly what I need, and I'm happy to keep it in my routine.

Product received this as a part of an educational promotion. I've been wearing this sunscreen for the last week and I'm actually really impressed. It feels super lightweight on the skin and doesn't have that typical chalky mineral SPF look at all. It has a light pink color to it and leaves no white cast on my skin. It blends in really nicely and just looks like skin. So far it wears comfortably and layers well under my makeup - definitely a good everyday option. I'll keep testing, but so far it's really good.

I've been using the TIMEBEAM Beauty Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50, and overall I think it's a nice everyday sunscreen. It feels comfortable on the skin and gives a soft dewy finish without feeling too heavy or greasy. It seems like a good option for daily wear, especially if you want sun protection with a bit of glow instead of a flat or dry finish. What I like is that it includes ingredients like niacinamide, green tea, and astaxanthin, which are known for helping support the skin barrier and giving antioxidant support. Those ingredients won't replace sunscreen protection, but they are a nice extra for helping skin feel calmer and more cared for. Overall, this feels like a well-rounded sunscreen that protects well, wears nicely, and makes skin look healthy without being too much. I received this product as part of educational promotion.

avis.titre: Effective Protection but Leaves a Slight White Cast
avis.texte: In my experience, the Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50 provided decent protection against the sun, but it was not perfect. The texture felt a bit thick when applying, which is common for mineral sunscreens, and it took some time to fully blend into my skin. I noticed a slight white cast, especially in natural lighting, which may be a concern for deeper skin tones. On the positive side, it did not cause any irritation and felt gentle on my skin throughout the day. It also stayed in place well and did not feel greasy after a few hours of wear. Overall, while it offers strong sun protection, the formula could be improved for easier application and a more natural finish.

Love the texture, love that it's pink for that little glow. Layers well under makeup. Has some great ingredients but made my skin super dry & flaky. I know maybe my skin just needs more time to adjust. Going to keep trying maybe adding a thicker moisturizer prior. I have combo skin but this one isn't working for me like I had hopes it would. Hoping maybe I can find a way to use it or my skin changes its mind as I love how pretty it goes on & layer with makeup etc. I was sent a bottle with the gummies (those are amazing!) to test for my opinion. Might work for others just not for me.

I've been using this product for a few weeks now, and I love it. This Timebeam sunbeam daily mineral sunscreen works great to protect and hydrate my skin. This sunscreen feels really nice on my skin it glides on smoothly, it is lightweight and fast absorbing it doesn't leave any white overcast like most sunscreen does, this one blends really well into the skin leaving it feeling super soft, and dewy, with a radiant glow. The color of this product is very cute and playful. This sunscreen is fragrance free, which makes it ideal for people with sensitive skin. I highly recommend giving this product a try. I received this product as part of an educational promotion.

I received this product as part of an educational promotion. I've been loving this Sunbeam Mineral Sunscreen. It leaves a healthy, radiant sheen I'm obsessed with. The formula is thick enough to feel substantial but still spreads easily across the skin. It absorbs well with no greasy residue and makes a perfect base for my makeup. The slim bottle is convenient to carry in my bag for travel or daytime touch-ups. My only minor issue was initially struggling to open the bottle. I couldn't tell if it twisted or pulled and was concerned I was going to ruin the bottle, but now that I realize it twists I appreciate that it won't spill in my bag. Overall, I really love this and the healthy looking glow it adds to my skin!

After using Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50 consistently for 7 days, I'm honestly impressed with how well it performs, especially for a mineral formula. The texture is lightweight and blends in much easier than I expected, with minimal white cast once fully absorbed. It feels breathable on the skin and doesn't leave that heavy, chalky finish that most mineral sunscreens tend to do. Throughout the week, I wore it daily under makeup and on bare skin, it layered beautifully without pilling or making my skin look greasy. Instead, it gave a soft, natural finish that actually helped smooth my complexion. I also appreciated how gentle it felt with no irritation, no clogged pores, and it worked well with my skin. In terms of protection, it held up great during sun exposure, keeping my skin from burning and preventing any redness. I also liked that it didn't have a strong sunscreen smell. Overall, this is a reliable, skin friendly mineral sunscreen that delivers strong SPF 50 protection while still feeling comfortable and wearable. After a full week of testing, it's definitely something I'd keep in my daily routine. Product was received as part of an educational promotion.

I've been trying quite a few SPFs lately and I quite enjoyed this one. The texture is thick and rich like a body cream. It's pink like calamine lotion, but it definitely blends into melanin skin. The scent is nostalgic, it reminds me of something from my childhood in the 80s. I just can't put my finger on it. It's not a bad frequence. It's actually quite pleasant. I just can't figure out what it reminds me of. It feels quite velvety and non-greasy. I enjoyed it in the packaging is cute too!

Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50 from Timebeam Beauty is a great addition to my routine. The cute pink packaging is secure but not always easy to open, though it becomes easier with regular use. The formula is lightweight and the sunscreen itself is pink with a green tea scent instead of a typical sunscreen smell. It gives a subtle glow without feeling greasy and should work well with most skin types. It layers nicely under a variety of foundations. This was sent to me in exchange for my honest review.

After trying Timebeam's Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen, I'm not very impressed. The formula itself has a light pink tint and feels nice when applied to the skin, which I did like. However, the scent is terrible! It's hard to describe, it's definitely not the typical sunscreen smell. Another issue I had was with the packaging. The cap was extremely difficult to remove. My boyfriend and I struggled with it for a couple of minutes before finally getting it open, which was frustrating. Overall, while the texture is nice but the smell and packaging issues outweigh the positives for me. I wouldn't recommend it. I also want to say that I received as a part of an educational promotion.

avis.titre: Mineral sunscreen that leaves no cast
avis.texte: I wear sunscreen everyday as part of my skincare routine without fall. As a woman of color with deep/dark skin, I wear chemical sunscreen because most mineral sunscreens leave behind a white cast. This sunscreen is pink in color and when I applied it to my skin and started rubbing it in it looked purplish (as most sunscreens do on dark skin), but as I continued rubbing it in it actually disappeared and left behind NO white cast. I applied two finger length of sunscreen on my skin and it actually absorbed well and didn't leave my combination skin greasy looking. It is described as leaving your skin dewy (which I feel usually means oily) but that was not the case and it is really lightweight. There are purported skin benefits like antioxidants, vitamin C, niacinamide, and hyaluronic acid so I appreciate when sunscreen doubles as skin care. I do have to deduct one star because I really do not care for the smell of this sunscreen. I don't know if it is the naturally pink antioxidant that they use, but the smell is one that I need to get accustomed to. If the smell didn't slightly bother me, this would have gotten 5 stars from me. I received this product as part of an educational promotion.

avis.titre: Daily coverage and dewy finish is where it's at!
avis.texte: Hands down the best sunscreen I've ever used I think! I always use it paired with the Sol Mate Sun Gummies and i swear I've never felt as protected from the mean sun as I do since I've discovered them. My complexion 3/4 of the year is tan but in the summer I spend so much time outside and get so dark I wouldn't survive without the best sunscreen ritual there is. I need high SPF always so the broad spectrum SPF 50 is perfect for me. And because I do spend so much time outdoors and do wear sunscreen 24/7 it's perfect because it's lightweight while still being hydrating and it's ultra blendable in case I decide to wear makeup. And you almost don't have to because it leaves a beautiful dewy natural glow to die for. Such a sexy product Timebeam! * I received this promotional product in exchange for my honest review

This is my MUST HAVE sunscreen. The BEST thing about this sunscreen is I can put it on my eyelids and under my eyes, it doesn't irritate my eyes AT ALL. The other well-known sunscreen I used for a long time really made my eyes sting if a bit got into them. This is my favorite sunscreen of all time. This product was gifted by Beautytap Official and Timebeam as a part of an educational promotion.

This sunscreen is quite thin (in a good way) and feels light on the skin. It does have a little glow to it- but somehow they have done it without it being a dewy/creamy texture. So if you are dewy adverse because of an oily fear, it's a good solution. The smell is not for me. The powerful antioxidant ingredients are great, and I think make this product unique by adding another delivery system to protect the skin. I received this in exchange for my honest review.

I had mixed first impressions of this sunscreen, but it ended up really growing on me. The scent is…interesting lol. It doesn't smell like traditional sunscreen at all, and tbh, it reminded me of like a super faint banana bread scent? Not bad, just unexpected. Also, the packaging was pretty frustrating at first. The bottle was really hard to open the first time, like I almost broke a nail trying to twist it open, and because I was gripping the bottle firmly, a whole bunch of product squirted out once I was able to get it open. That said, the formula is great. The texture is super lightweight, more like a serum or ampoule than that typical thick sunscreen texture, which I love. It comes out pink, which had me worried it would be one of those tone-up formulas (those never work for my medium skin tone), but it blends into my skin completely with zero white cast. It gives a really nice natural glow without feeling greasy or sticky, it feels comfortable and lightweight on the skin, and it doesn't sting the eyes. No issues with pilling either, so it layers really well under makeup. Overall, aside from the tricky packaging and slightly odd scent, the formula itself is really solid. If you like lightweight, glowy sunscreens that sit well under makeup, this is definitely worth trying.

Timebeam Beauty Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum Spectrum SPF 50 seems to be a good product. I haven't truly had enough time to test its strength! It is lightweight and the fragrance is minimal which is a huge plus for me. I received this product as part of a promotion for my honest review.

This is a great sunscreen for all day wear. It's defiantly on of those sunscreens that are so lightweight that it feels like simple skincare. What stands out most is how lightweight, creamy, and non‑greasy it is. It's a sunscreen that melts into the skin and leaves zero white cast, even on medium to deep skin tones. This is definitely the kind of spf you can wear each day without a worry of a greasy feeling. The texture is soft and airy which makes it ideal for daily wear. It does not sit in the sit and leaves a natural finish. It also does well under makeup. There was no patchiness and no pilling. If you want a sunscreen that feels like a hydrating skincare step, leaves your skin glowing, and disappears completely on all skin tones I would recommend this one. *this was received in pair with a product promotion for my honest review

Great addition to my skincare routine since it's very important to use SPF everyday. I love this timebeam sunscreen protection because it gives me the best that is SPF 50. the bottle it's so beautiful and the texture it's great for my skin type. *I received this product for as part of an educational promotion.

**Incentivized Review** I've been using the Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50, and I'm honestly so impressed. It blends in beautifully for a mineral sunscreen with no heavy white cast, just a smooth, natural finish that sits really well under makeup. It protects skin at a cellular level, rather than blocking the physical rays. This paired with SPF 50 can increase the skin's resistance to UV damage, reduce inflammation, and reduce edema caused by sunburn. It helps to preserve collagen and elastin in the face. This is my go to product all Spring and Summer!

This is the first time I have tried TimeBeam sunscreen with SPF 50. First the pink cute bottle packaging is eye catching and its now always in my bag with me. Its easy to take out from the bottle. The pink color with perfect texture absorbs quicky on my skin without greasy yet glowy look. It does not have any fragance. The dewy glow suncreen work as best primer. It suits on my face and it work good to improve my skintone. I highly recommend this Suncreen and would continue using it.

This Sunscreen is a grest size to fit in your pocket or your purse to take on the go. The lid stays very well sealed on it also. It smells good and it has a nice texture, i also like that its pink. Its not greasy and a little goes a long way.

However I did use it on my face a few times and had no issues with it breaking my skin out. When first applied the application looks pink, but when rubbed in, it blends well with your skin tone. I am relatively fair skinned so I'm not sure of how it would be on darker complexions. The sunscreen has the "slightest" bit of shimmer in it which only can be seen in full sun. I suppose that's where the dewiness comes from. I think it's a great option for mineral sunscreen. I don't get a white cast whatsoever! The bottle lid is a bit difficult to open so keep that in mind if you have limited dexterity or arthritis. I received this as a part of an educational promotion.

I'm a 38 year old beauty enthusiast that needs all the help I can get when it comes to sun protection. I love a good mineral sunscreen so I was excited to try the Timebeam Beauty Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50. This product has a lightweight serum-like texture that is easy to spread across the skin and absorbs quickly. It is hydrating and leaves a dewy finish without feeling sticky or greasy. The Sunbeam SPF contains antioxidants such as green tea and astaxanthin which is 6,000 times stronger than vitamin C and gives this sunscreen it's light pink color. As you rub it into the skin, the pink color fades and blends in without leaving any white/pink cast behind. I really love this sunscreen formula but unfortunately it falls short on the packaging. The first time I used it I struggled to get it open. I was afraid that it was going to break. I did manage to figure it out and with time and multiple uses, it's gotten easier to open. But initially it was a bit confusing and difficult to open. Overall, I'm happy with the sunscreen and how hydrating, lightweight, and comfortable it is. I know I'll really enjoy using this product during the summer months when I'm looking for something thinner and more lightweight. **I received this product as part of an educational promotion.

So I would recommend reapplying more frequently, especially under strong sunlight. Overall, it's a nice everyday mineral sunscreen with a soft texture and look, but for intense sun exposure, I'd be a bit more careful and make sure to reapply regularly. The Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50 from Timebeam Beauty offers protection from the sun's harmful UV rays alongside a dewy glow. The active ingredient here doing the bulk of the work is zinc oxide 10% which I love as someone with acne prone skin. In addition to the zinc oxide Timebeam also utilizes astaxanthin which is a carotenoid antioxidant that helps shield skin from oxidative stress. Green Tea which is an antioxidant that helps combat free radicals and calm skin. And also niacinamide to help strengthen the skin barrier and improve skin tone. The sunscreen is tinted pink so you get none of the usual white cast that mineral sunscreens are infamous for having. The texture is very thin and liquidy which I would describe as being more similar to a serum than a typical sunscreen. The only issue I've had with this product is that it took me an embarrassingly long time to figure out that I'm supposed to twist the lid off to open! Otherwise this is an excellent product and my current favorite mineral sunscreen! I received this as a part of an educational promotion.

avis.titre: Greenlit—great option for daily mineral sunscreen.

It works perfectly as a makeup base and does not interfere with how my makeup looks or lasts. Highly recommend for everyday use!

The lightweight feeling, hydrating effects and the serum-like texture are all my favorite about this product.

avis.titre: Finally a sunscreen that makes me glow!
avis.texte: This sunscreen makes me feel cool. I think part of it is the shape of the bottle. It's unique and playful, but the even better part is that the sunscreen itself is really well formulated. It doesn't leave a white cast at all, which is so cool for a mineral sunscreen. The pink hue of the sunscreen doesn't read pink on my face at all, but rather gives a youthful glow. It disappears on my skin, which is awesome because no one wants to feel a heavy sunscreen in the warmth of summer. Or ever. If you're like me, you'll appreciate knowing that the cap twists off. It took me an embarrassingly long while to figure out how to take the cap off, but my seven year old figured it out immediately, so it seems like user error haha. I really loved this sunscreen.
